objective: Run a current full FusionDB benchmark snapshot and summarize capability, performance, copy-load readiness, and external benchmark gaps.

tasks.title: Current full benchmark snapshot
expected_changes: Build the current release FusionDB binary.
Run all local benchmark suites at small and medium scale.
Run external benchmark readiness detection for pgbench, sysbench, memtier, BenchBase TPC-C, TSBS, LDBC, and CH-benCHmark.
Record pass/fail, suite-level latency distributions, slow case signals, throughput cases, and production gaps.

verification_results.command: python fusiondb_matrix.py --scale small --suite all --load-mode insert --run-name matrix_all_small_insert_full_20260527 --threads 4 --suite-timeout 1800 --allow-failures
python fusiondb_matrix.py --scale medium --suite all --load-mode insert --run-name matrix_all_medium_insert_full_20260527 --threads 4 --suite-timeout 3600 --allow-failures
